title: Reading a card
summary: Name, mana cost, type line, text box, power and toughness.

checklist.label: I can find a card's name and mana cost
I can read the type line
I know the text box says what a card does
I know what power and toughness mean

steps.title: The parts of a card
steps.body:
Every Magic card uses the same layout. Once you know it, you can read any card.

From top to bottom:

- **Name** at the top, and [[mana-cost]] in the top-right corner
- **Picture**
- [[type-line|Type line]]
- **Text box**: what the card does
- [[power-toughness|Power and toughness]] in the bottom-right corner (creatures only)

visual.altText: Brazen Scourge: name at the top, mana cost on the picture, type line, text box, and power and toughness in the corner.

steps.title: Name and mana cost
steps.body:
Our example is **Brazen Scourge**, a real card from the Foundations set. Its name is at the top left.

In the top-right corner is its mana cost: {1}{R}{R}. That means **two red mana** plus **one mana of any colour**. You pay it to cast the card.

Add up every symbol and you get its [[mana-value|mana value]]: 3.

visual.altText: Brazen Scourge, costing one generic and two red mana.

check.question: Brazen Scourge costs {1}{R}{R}: one generic and two red mana. What do you need to pay?

options.text: Two red mana, plus one mana of any colour
Any three mana, no red needed

check.hint: The grey number can be paid with any colour. Each red symbol must be paid with red.

steps.title: The type line
steps.body:
Under the picture is the [[type-line|type line]]. Brazen Scourge's says **Creature — Gremlin**.

- **Creature** is its [[card-type|card type]]. It tells you what the card is and when you can play it.
- **Gremlin** is its subtype. Subtypes only matter when another card mentions them.

You'll meet every card type in Module 4.

visual.src: The middle of the card, showing the words Creature — Gremlin.
visual.altText: A type line reading Creature, Gremlin.

steps.title: The text box
steps.body:
The text box says what the card does. Brazen Scourge's says **Haste**.

Haste is a [[keyword]]: one word that stands for a longer rule. You'll learn the common keywords in Module 8.

Some cards also have flavour text, printed in a different style. It's a little bit of story and never changes how the card plays.

visual.src: The card's text box with the keyword Haste, and a short line of flavour text below it.
visual.altText: A text box with the keyword Haste and some flavour text.

check.question: What does flavour text change about how a card plays?

options.text: Nothing. It's just a bit of story

check.hint: Look at the last sentence of this step.

steps.title: Power and toughness
steps.body:
A creature has two numbers in its bottom-right corner. Brazen Scourge shows **3/3**.

- **Power** (the first 3): the [[damage]] it deals in combat.
- **Toughness** (the second 3): how much damage destroys it in one turn.

So the Scourge hits for 3, and 3 damage is enough to destroy it.

visual.src: The bottom-right corner of the card, showing 3/3.

check.question: A creature shows 3/4. How much damage destroys it in one turn?
